name: oral_argument_question_purpose_legal_bench
description: A labeled dataset that classifies the communicative purpose of questions asked during legal oral arguments (e.g., clarification, challenge, policy probing). It measures a model's ability to identify the intent behind courtroom questions to support legal NLP applications such as argument analysis and summarization.
reputation: Niche, hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption and few citations to date.
